test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

Mother said that when we pluck a flower it dies so we should let it beautify the world as long as it lives.

options.text: Mother said, “When we pluck a flower it dies so you should let it beautify the world as long as it lived.”
Mother said, “When we plucked a flower it died so we should let it beautify the world as long as it lived.”
Mother says, “When we pluck a flower it dies so we should let it beautify the world as long as it lives.”
Mother said, “When we pluck a flower it dies so we should let it beautify the world as long as it lives.”

solution:
The correct answer is **'Mother said, “When we pluck a flower it dies so we should let it beautify the world as long as it lives.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• To change from *indirect to direct speech*, we use the following steps - 

 
 
• The reporting verb said remains unchanged.
 
• Put a comma (,) after 'Mother said...'
 
• Remove the conjunction that.
 
• Insert inverted commas ("...") to mark the statement part of the direct speech.
 
• Capitalize the first word of the statement. (When)
 
• Since the tense in the statement should be in present tense, none of the verbs are changed. 
 
 
 
• When we follow the above steps, we get the following sentence - Mother said, “When we pluck a flower it dies so we should let it beautify the world as long as it lives."
 
• Thus, option 4 is the correct answer.
